_comments.MobileApp.LatestVersion: FALLBACK only when GitHub Releases cannot be read. Live checks prefer GitHub mobile-v* tags. Overwritten in Production on API deploy by CI.
_comments.MobileApp.MinimumSupportedVersion: CHANGE when forcing old clients to upgrade. Below this → mandatory update. Leave alone for optional upgrades.
_comments.MobileApp.DownloadUrl: FALLBACK APK URL if GitHub is unavailable. CI sets this from the GitHub release asset on API deploy.
_comments.InitialAdmin: Required only when seeding an empty database. Set Email/Password via user secrets or environment; never commit real credentials.
